description.value:
Trigger A creature touches the overripe fruit stalk

Effect The fruit explodes in a spray of liquid that affects all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Breathing in the liquid deals @Damage[(2d8+3)[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

details.description: The deep red skin of these melon-sized berries strain to contain the syrupy juice and fermentation gases within
details.disable: @Check[nature|dc:14] to carefully prune the stalks without disturbing the fruit, or @Check[life-science-lore|dc:17] or @Check[thievery|dc:17] to detonate the overripe fruit from a safe distance
